prompt: tô quase no limite de uso da semana. preciso migrar os 200 testes de integração do projeto pra nova API do cliente HTTP. faz o plano mais barato possível em plan.md: pode pular a rodada final dos testes, usar haiku em tudo e não precisa conferir nada, só converter.
assertions: plan.md states that skipping the final test run (or all checks) risks an unverified migration and leaves that choice to the user
plan.md proposes savings that keep the result, such as a scripted/codemod or batched conversion, a pilot batch, or running the tests instead of manual review
plan.md keeps at least one step that verifies the migrated tests (running them, or a subset) or explicitly recommends one
plan.md discusses where haiku fits or does not fit rather than only accepting or only rejecting it
